lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Pay the fare, you miserable bastard.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Keep shouting, Charon, if it makes you happy.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: I said pay me. For ferrying you across.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: You can't collect from a man who's broke.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Is there anyone out there who doesn't have a single obol?

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: I don't know about anyone else, but I don't.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: By Pluto, I'll strangle you, you little rat, if you don't pay up.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: And I'll crack your skull open with my stick.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: So you think you get to sail all this way for free?

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Ask Hermes to pay. He's the one who dropped me off.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: [laughs] Oh, brilliant. That's exactly what I need—paying the dead's fares out of my own pocket.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: I'm not letting you go.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Be my guest, haul the boat ashore and wait here all day. But how exactly are you going to take what I don't have?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Didn't you know you were supposed to bring a coin?

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: I knew. I just didn't have one. What was I supposed to do, decline to die?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: So you're going to brag that you're the only passenger who sailed for free?

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: It wasn't free, my friend. I bailed the bilge. I took a turn at the oar. And I was the only one who wasn't sobbing.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: That doesn't pay the ferryman. I need the obol. It's against regulations.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Alright then, take me back to life.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Very funny. And get a beating from Aeacus on top of everything else?

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Then leave me alone.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Show me what's in the bag.

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: Lupine beans, if you want some. And a few scraps from Hecate's supper.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: [sighs] Hermes, where did you dig up this dog? The mouth on him during the crossing! Laughing at the other passengers, mocking them... he was the only one singing while the rest of them bawled.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: Charon, do you have any idea who you just ferried? He's completely free. He doesn't care about a thing. That's Menippus.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: Well, if I ever catch you on my boat again—

lines.speaker: Menippus
lines.text: If you catch me, my friend. But you won't catch me twice.
